exposure: weight at the beginning of pregnancy
cohort: The study included 400 pregnant women (28-40 weeks of pregnancy) referred to health centers in Zahedan.
finding: There was a significant correlation between the score of dietary diversity (including specific food groups like dairy and vegetables) and newborns' anthropometric indices at birth, with dietary diversity increasing with rising family income.
cross-section timing: Data was collected in 2016 during the third trimester of pregnancy and at birth.
